summary.text: Nels Pierson is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election and a former state representative.
He represented District 26B in the Minnesota House of Representatives from January 2015 to January 2023.

paragraphs.text: Pierson assumed office in the Minnesota House on January 6, 2015, and was re-elected in 2018 and 2020.

His committee assignments in 2015 included Agriculture Finance, Education Innovation Policy, Health and Human Services Finance and Health and Human Services Reform; in 2017 they included Agriculture Finance, Agriculture Policy, Capital Investment and Health and Human Services Finance.
He did not run for re-election in 2022 and left office on January 3, 2023.
